description: Answers 'how much of this backtest's return is survivorship bias?' Give a spec (same format as run_backtest, universe top500/top1000/top3000 or a symbol list). Returns both stats plus the inflation in CAGR and Sharpe that survivorship bias adds. Runs it twice - once on the point-in-time universe (delisted companies included while they traded, the honest result) and once on only the names still trading today. Costs one backtest. Free keys audit the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

dry_run.description: true: check the spec and report what would run and what it would cost, without running it or charging. Default false.
